localizedrain.configuration.title: Localized Rain Configs
localizedrain.configuration.maxParentEnt: Hard cap on stored biome-segment parent entries per dimension
localizedrain.configuration.maxColumnSca: Maximum biome column scans per tick
localizedrain.configuration.logWeatherCh: Log biome patch weather changes with position and type
localizedrain.configuration.weatherMode: Weather system mode: biome patches / moving storms / vanilla
localizedrain.configuration.isolatedBiom: Weather inside isolated biomes (clear / patch / manual)
localizedrain.configuration.maxStormsPer: Maximum natural storms near one player
localizedrain.configuration.maxManualSto: Maximum manual storms per dimension (0 disables them)
localizedrain.configuration.despawnDista: Distance at which a natural storm starts to fade (blocks)
localizedrain.configuration.despawnGrace: How long a natural storm must stay far away before fading (ticks)
localizedrain.configuration.falloffRatio: Storm intensity falloff band width (fraction of radius)
Width of the storm intensity falloff band, as a fraction of the storm radius; larger values give a softer edge.
localizedrain.configuration.stormRadiusB:
Base radius for newly spawned storms, in blocks.
0 = use the profile's radius range; when > 0, the value is used as the center and stormRadiusVariance is applied.
localizedrain.configuration.stormRadiusV: Random variation applied to stormRadiusBase, as a fraction (0.3 = +/-30%). Only used when stormRadiusBase > 0.
localizedrain.configuration.debugLogging:
Logs 3D patch diagnostics: column scans, component merges and the player's resolved patch.
Useful for debugging weather boundaries; keep disabled in normal play.
localizedrain.configuration.logWeatherCh:
Logs every biome patch weather change (type / raining / thundering), including the patch position, biome and the previous weather signature.
Can be noisy while many patches cycle; enable only for debugging.
localizedrain.configuration.logStormSpaw: Logs a detailed line (dimension, id, profile, position, radius, vertical range, stage, weather type, intensity, velocity, manual flag and lifetime) whenever a storm spawns.

Whenever a storm spawns, send every player in that dimension a chat message with the center (x, z), Y range, radius and weather type.
Natural storms are infrequent (usually one every few minutes); turn this off if you do not want the messages.
localizedrain.configuration.minClearTick: Shortest clear-weather duration (ticks). Each biome patch re-rolls its next clear period from this range.
localizedrain.configuration.maxClearTick: Longest clear-weather duration (ticks). Together with the minimum it defines the random clear period.
localizedrain.configuration.minRainTicks: Shortest rain duration (ticks). Each patch re-rolls the next rain period when rain ends.
localizedrain.configuration.minThunderDe: Minimum delay after rain starts before the first thunderstorm (ticks).
localizedrain.configuration.maxThunderDe: Maximum delay after rain starts before the first thunderstorm (ticks).
localizedrain.configuration.weatherSimul:
How often biome patches in loaded chunks are advanced (ticks).
Each sweep advances every patch by this many ticks, so the overall weather rate is unchanged: 1 = every tick, 20 = once per second.
localizedrain.configuration.scan3dSubsta:
Also advance weather for cave / floating-island biome sub-states inside loaded chunks.
Every non-empty 16-block section of a loaded chunk is sampled once per sweep; disable to scan only each chunk's surface column.
localizedrain.configuration.stateRetenti:
Delete stored weather states that have not been advanced for this many in-game days.
0 = keep them forever (the size cap still applies). One in-game day is 24000 ticks.
localizedrain.configuration.maxStoredSta: Hard cap on stored weather states per dimension; when exceeded, least recently advanced states are removed first.
localizedrain.configuration.maxParentEnt:
Hard cap on stored biome-segment parent entries per dimension.
The parent map is pruned down to this size when it grows beyond it, evicting unreferenced stateless nodes and their column caches; evicted columns re-register on the next scan.
The default is about 4x the weather state cap (4096); too high a value causes frequent pruning in heavily explored worlds.
localizedrain.configuration.maxColumnSca:
How many new 16x16 columns may be scanned per tick for 3D biome patches.
Each column costs a vertical biome sampling pass; lower values reduce first-visit hitching at the cost of slower patch discovery.
Weather system mode. Newly created worlds default to moving storms; changes apply within about a second (or use /weather mode).
Biome patches: existing 3D biome-patch weather.
Moving storms: moving storms with wind, evolution and 3D coverage.
Vanilla: do not take over vanilla weather at all.
localizedrain.configuration.isolatedBiom:
Weather inside biomes tagged #localizedrain:storm_isolated (mobile mode only).
clear = always clear.
patch = keep running the biome-patch weather machine for those patches.
manual = clear unless set by command or API.
localizedrain.configuration.naturalCaveS: Allow storms to spawn naturally underground (mobile mode only).
localizedrain.configuration.caveStormRad: Radius of naturally spawned cave storms, in blocks.
localizedrain.configuration.maxStormsPer: Maximum number of natural storms per dimension (manual storms do not use this budget).
Maximum number of natural storms considered to belong to one player (within 1.5x the maximum spawn distance).
localizedrain.configuration.maxManualSto: Maximum number of manual storms per dimension (commands/API). 0 disables manual storms.
localizedrain.configuration.spawnInterva: How often (in ticks) a dimension attempts to spawn one natural storm.
localizedrain.configuration.spawnMinDist: Minimum spawn distance from the chosen player, in blocks.
localizedrain.configuration.spawnMaxDist: Maximum spawn distance from the chosen player, in blocks.
localizedrain.configuration.naturalStorm: Chance that each check (every spawnIntervalTicks, default 200 ticks = 10 s) actually spawns a natural storm. 0.035 is about one storm every 4.8 minutes; 0 disables natural spawning, 1 spawns on every check.
localizedrain.configuration.stormSpawnPl: near_player: spawn near a random player along the wind (respects the per-player cap); anywhere_loaded: spawn at a random loaded chunk (ignores the per-player cap).
localizedrain.configuration.windChangeIn: How often (in ticks) the dimension wind direction and speed are re-rolled.
localizedrain.configuration.windMinSpeed: Minimum wind speed in blocks per tick.
localizedrain.configuration.windMaxSpeed: Maximum wind speed in blocks per tick.
localizedrain.configuration.despawnDista: A natural storm this far from every player starts its despawn grace timer, in blocks.
localizedrain.configuration.despawnGrace: How long a natural storm must stay too far away before it fades out, in ticks.
localizedrain.configuration.stormSyncInt: How often (in ticks) the full storm list is re-sent to clients as a correction.
localizedrain.configuration.falloffRatio: Width of the storm intensity falloff band, as a fraction of the storm radius; larger values give a softer edge.
localizedrain.configuration.lightningMul: Lightning frequency multiplier for storms; 0 disables storm lightning.
localizedrain.configuration.weatherBiome:
Weather whitelist: biomes only cycle the weather listed here; any weather not listed never occurs.
Format: '<biome selector>=<weather>', one entry per weather, for example 'minecraft:plains=clear' and 'minecraft:plains=localizedrain:rain'.
Weather may be a type id, clear/rain/thunder, or a weather type tag like '#localizedrain:dry'.
Empty = use the default natural pool (#localizedrain:natural, or built-in clear/rain/thunder).
Biome selectors: 'minecraft:desert', 'minecraft:*' (namespace), '#minecraft:is_ocean' (biome tag).

Weather blacklist: biomes never get the weather listed here, but still cycle through their remaining weather.
For example 'minecraft:desert=localizedrain:rain' keeps deserts rainless while they may still thunder.
Format and biome selectors are the same as the whitelist; weather type tags are supported, and blacklisted weather is removed from the whitelist pool.

Forced weather: matching biomes always stay in exactly one weather type.
Format: '<biome selector>=<weather>', for example 'minecraft:desert=clear'.
Only one weather per biome is supported; when several entries match, the FIRST entry (top to bottom) wins.
Weather tags are not allowed here; clear/rain/thunder map to the built-in types.
A biome forced to clear never receives weather, not even from commands or the API.
